description: Business Central style vendor ledger with an internal 'Document No.' (PI-001842) next to the supplier's 'External Document No.' (KIS-24581), invoices as negative amounts and a 'Remaining Amount' column; the statement has a per-document 'Outstanding' column that is not a running balance.

notes.reference column: The statement uses the supplier's numbers: the ledger's External Document No. column must be chosen over the internal Document No.
notes.balance: 'Outstanding' is per document: it must not be read as a running balance (no false inconsistency).
